libraries.name: batch
libraries.dune:
; The batch seam: the port's one network-ingress boundary. This library sits
; above BOTH tn_evm and tn_execution (which cannot see each other), so the
; TN-mirror wire decoder, the batch validator and the payload seam can compose
; the two without touching any existing dune file.
(library
 (name tn_batch)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.batch)
 (libraries tn_std tn_codec tn_crypto tn_types tn_rlp tn_keccak tn_evm
   tn_consensus tn_execution zarith))

libraries.name: codec
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_codec)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.codec))

libraries.name: consensus
libraries.dune:
; tn_keccak and tn_hash32 are DIRECT dependencies because the sub-DAG
; randomness is keccak256, a fixed protocol fact rather than a link-time seam
; choice, and it is carried as the 32-byte gate. tn_rand is direct because the
; leader swap draws from rand 0.9.2's ChaCha12 StdRng. All three are acyclic:
; tn_rand -> tn_hash32 -> tn_keccak -> digestif is a leaf chain and none of
; them names tn_consensus.
(library
 (name tn_consensus)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.consensus)
 (libraries tn_std tn_codec tn_crypto tn_types tn_vertex tn_keccak tn_hash32
   tn_rand))

libraries.name: crypto
libraries.dune:
; Virtual library: declares the interface (tn_crypto.mli) with no
; implementation. Exactly one implementation library (default
; tn_crypto_stub) is linked per executable. See lib/crypto_stub/.
(library
 (name tn_crypto)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.crypto)
 (virtual_modules tn_crypto)
 (default_implementation telcoin_ocaml.crypto_stub))

libraries.name: crypto_blst
libraries.dune:
; The real implementation of the virtual tn_crypto library: pure-OCaml
; BLAKE3 (the private Blake3 module — no opam blake3 dependency exists for
; this toolchain) plus BLS12-381 min-sig aggregation via bls12-381 and
; bls12-381-signature. Selected per executable by naming
; telcoin_ocaml.crypto_blst in that executable's (libraries ...); every
; existing executable keeps resolving to the stub default.
(library
 (name tn_crypto_blst)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.crypto_blst)
 (implements telcoin_ocaml.crypto)
 (libraries bls12-381 bls12-381-signature hex))

libraries.name: crypto_stub
libraries.dune:
; The default implementation of the virtual tn_crypto library: a deterministic
; forgeable stub for simulation. Provides tn_crypto.ml against the interface in
; lib/crypto/tn_crypto.mli.
(library
 (name tn_crypto_stub)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.crypto_stub)
 (implements telcoin_ocaml.crypto)
 (libraries digestif))

libraries.name: driver
libraries.dune:
; The execution driver: the library that owns the consensus-chain accumulator
; and the engine, feeding committed outputs through the batch-body seam. It
; sits above tn_engine, and nothing but the test suite sits above it. It must
; NEVER list tn_sim: the sim is a consensus shell below the batch seam, and
; the test suite is the wiring layer where the two meet. Every library any
; module here names is listed explicitly, as every other library in this repo
; does: the implicit transitive closure is never relied on.
(library
 (name tn_driver)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.driver)
 (libraries tn_types tn_state tn_evm tn_keccak tn_consensus tn_execution
   tn_batch tn_engine zarith))

libraries.name: durable
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_durable)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.durable)
 (libraries unix digestif))

libraries.name: durable_checkpoint
libraries.dune:
; The durable checkpoint: the execution side's small artefact, published by
; rename. It is a library of its own so the dependency edge from storage to the
; whole execution stack (state, evm, engine, driver) is drawn once and in one
; place; nothing below it learns that a checkpoint exists. Every library any
; module here names is listed explicitly, as every other library in this repo
; does: the implicit transitive closure is never relied on.
(library
 (name tn_durable_checkpoint)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.durable_checkpoint)
 (libraries tn_durable tn_durable_store tn_codec tn_crypto tn_keccak tn_types
   tn_execution tn_state tn_evm tn_engine tn_driver))

libraries.name: durable_store
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_durable_store)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.durable_store)
 (libraries tn_durable tn_codec tn_crypto tn_types tn_consensus tn_execution))

libraries.name: engine
libraries.dune:
; The execution engine: the library that folds one committed consensus output
; into the execution blocks it produces. It sits above tn_batch (which already
; sits above both tn_evm and tn_execution), and nothing but tn_driver (the
; execution driver, chunk 37) and the test suite sits above it. Every library
; any module here names is listed explicitly, as every
; other library in this repo does: the implicit transitive closure is never
; relied on.
(library
 (name tn_engine)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.engine)
 (libraries tn_std tn_types tn_crypto tn_keccak tn_hash32 tn_state tn_evm
   tn_consensus tn_execution tn_batch zarith))

libraries.name: evm
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_evm)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.evm)
 (libraries tn_types tn_state tn_keccak tn_rlp tn_trie tn_crypto tn_hash32 tn_rand zarith
   digestif))

libraries.name: execution
libraries.dune:
; tn_std, tn_vertex and tn_hash32 became DIRECT dependencies when the genesis
; anchor stopped being a placeholder constant: computing it builds Rust's
; default Header (tn_vertex) inside a singleton Nonempty (tn_std), and the
; block's [extra] field is the 32-byte gate (tn_hash32). Every one of them
; already sits below tn_consensus, so no edge is new to the graph.
(library
 (name tn_execution)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.execution)
 (libraries tn_std tn_codec tn_crypto tn_types tn_hash32 tn_vertex
   tn_consensus))

libraries.name: hash32
libraries.dune:
; The 32-byte gate as a leaf. It lived in tn_evm until chunk 32, when the
; committee shuffle put tn_rand BELOW tn_evm (the shuffle consumes the RNG),
; while tn_rand still needs this type for its seed; a leaf both can see is
; the only acyclic home. tn_evm re-exports it as Tn_evm.Hash32, so every
; existing reference and the type equality survive the move.
(library
 (name tn_hash32)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.hash32)
 (libraries tn_keccak))

libraries.name: keccak
libraries.dune:
; Keccak-256 is a leaf: it depends on nothing else in this port, so both
; tn_state (for a code hash) and tn_evm (for KECCAK256) can sit above it
; without either depending on the other.
(library
 (name tn_keccak)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.keccak)
 (libraries digestif))

libraries.name: network
libraries.dune:
; The pure slice of telcoin-network's p2p layer: wire framing, message
; codecs and the pure state machines that sit behind them. Placement follows
; the chunk-44 ground truth's layering recommendation (GT:1017, dune
; convention GT:977): this library sits ABOVE tn_consensus the way tn_sim
; does, so Node.command and Node.event are consumed here and never modified
; there. Nothing below this library names it, so the graph stays acyclic.
(library
 (name tn_network)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.network)
 ; tn_crypto is DIRECT here because the wire leaf codecs rebuild the port's
 ; digest newtypes out of 32 wire bytes (Digests.*.of_digest takes a
 ; Tn_crypto.Digest.t), exactly as lib/vertex/header.ml does. The BLS key and
 ; signature FIELDS deliberately do not go through the seam: their wire widths
 ; are 96 and 48 bytes, a property of the Rust wire rather than of whichever
 ; crypto seam is linked, so they are opaque byte newtypes here and convert at
 ; the ingress boundary only.
 (libraries tn_std tn_codec tn_snappy tn_types tn_crypto tn_vertex
   tn_consensus))

libraries.name: rand
libraries.dune:
; rand 0.9.2's StdRng (ChaCha12) restricted to what the epoch-close committee
; shuffle consumes: the keystream, the u32/u64 draws, the usize range sampler
; and the choose_multiple reservoir. Depends on tn_hash32 only for the seed
; type (the close-epoch randomness arrives as that 32-byte gate); tn_evm sits
; ABOVE this library since chunk 32, because the committee shuffle calls it.
(library
 (name tn_rand)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.rand)
 (libraries tn_hash32))

libraries.name: rlp
libraries.dune:
; RLP (Recursive Length Prefix) is a leaf codec: it depends on nothing else in
; this port. Keeping it free of keccak and of the trie lets the later receipt,
; transaction and header chunks reuse it without pulling in the Merkle trie.
(library
 (name tn_rlp)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.rlp))

libraries.name: sim
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_sim)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.sim)
 (libraries tn_std tn_crypto tn_types tn_vertex tn_consensus tn_execution))

libraries.name: snappy
libraries.dune:
; Snappy is generic compression, not network-specific, so it is a leaf
; library of its own the way tn_keccak and tn_hash32 are: tn_network (chunk
; 44) sits above it and keeps its own dependency list minimal, and nothing
; here needs anything above tn_std.
(library
 (name tn_snappy)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.snappy)
 (libraries tn_std))

libraries.name: state
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_state)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.state)
 (libraries tn_types tn_keccak))

libraries.name: std
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_std)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.std))

libraries.name: trie
libraries.dune:
; The Merkle-Patricia-Trie root builder. It is where Keccak, RLP and the nibble
; path encoding meet: a trie root is [keccak256] of the RLP of a tree whose keys
; are nibble paths. Keeping it above tn_rlp (a domain-independent codec reused by
; the later receipt, transaction and header chunks) lets those chunks depend on
; RLP without pulling in the trie.
(library
 (name tn_trie)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.trie)
 (libraries tn_rlp tn_keccak tn_state tn_types))

libraries.name: types
libraries.dune:
; tn_hash32 is the 32-byte gate Block_num_hash needs for the execution block
; hash in a header. The edge is acyclic: tn_hash32 -> tn_keccak -> digestif is
; a leaf chain and neither of those libraries names tn_types.
(library
 (name tn_types)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.types)
 (libraries tn_crypto tn_codec tn_hash32))

libraries.name: vertex
libraries.dune:
(library
 (name tn_vertex)
 (public_name telcoin_ocaml.vertex)
 (libraries tn_crypto tn_codec tn_types))
